62882e632a:
If peace lasts, there's no need for Gundams, huh...
Nah, enough. Let's hurry up and send 'em into the sun.
So long, partner...!
0410d6a7b4: Yeah, yeah. You've got it bad for her, huh!
2d4b43ef11: Yes, this is how Operation Meteor should have been.
18c9c88732:
Zero... Can you move?
...All right. This is our last sortie.
806e484a21:
The Earth Sphere Unified Nation was founded,
and the world set out on the path of total pacifism
advocated by Relena Darlian.
bbb5c316ec:
In keeping with the decision to abandon all weapons,
Duo Maxwell was loading their Gundams onto a
disposal satellite to send them into the sun.
101aa93094:
One year later, a rebel force opposed to the Unified
Nation's government deployed a large number of MS
in a European city and staged a coup.
5b6708e283:
Heero Yuy, who had gone into hiding after the war,
learned that Relena, now a government official,
had been kidnapped by the rebels.
de38898f70: Heero and Duo set out to rescue Relena.
e05d534cdc:
Trowa Barton, acting apart from Heero, recovered the
Gundams from the disposal satellite, met up with Heero
and Duo in Earth orbit, and descended to Earth.
7ad00afcb1:
There's nothing left...
The self-destruct could clean up about half of 'em...
What do we do?
bca750519f:
If we were gonna withdraw, we'd have run in the first
place. Though fighting on like this is pretty rough.
a94b74e5d6:
Eh, don't worry about it.
I'm actually pretty good at fighting losing battles!
7d787b42a5:
They're the same as we once were.
They can only find meaning in their existence by fighting as soldiers.
5708862984:
They're just dancing to history's endless cycle
of war, peace and revolution!
cbc73942e9:
Confirming.
The shelter shield is perfect, right?
6509867773:
Peace is not something someone else gives you.
It is something you win with your own strength!
1c37073779:
What we need now is not ideologies or slogans,
but hearts that wish for peace!
4ed0a5a1c8:
I... won't kill anyone anymore...
I won't... have to kill...
9977601b57: This really is the last time, partner.
a713620b27:
Isn't that fine?
Trowa can just stay Trowa.
0d5bb1d4dc:
Names are something other people decide.
No use fussing over it yourself.
Besides, we've got somewhere to go home to, right?
d6f06b0d56:
Duo and the others are steadily cornered by the rebels.
Even with Milliardo arriving as reinforcement,
they fall into a disadvantage.
f5c92ae1f8:
Just as Duo and the others prepare for death,
the Wing Gundam Zero appears in the sky
above the rebels' headquarters.
b9c7fbd344:
Knowing that Relena is held prisoner there,
Heero still fires the Twin Buster Rifle.
Relena braces herself to be killed by Heero.
de569e87ff:
Having lost their leader, the rebels lay down
their arms at the desperate urging of Relena,
who escaped unharmed, and the incident ends.
66ab53e5e2:
This time, Duo and the others really dispose of the
Gundams, destroying their machines completely
with the self-destruct devices.
a1f4bd732e:
Milliardo, who came to help Heero and the others,
confirmed his sister Relena was safe, then vanished
once again without meeting her.
7dfe1f2c22:
In the history that followed, weapons, Gundams
included, never appeared again.
